menu.tagline: It has waited for you longer than you think.
menu.story: You wake up in an abandoned psychiatric ward. The power is out. Without electricity you can't call the elevator, and without the basement you can't get outside. It is hunting you. Collect fuses, power up the panels, and don't shine your flashlight carelessly.

note.title: NOTE
floor0.title: WARD No. 9 — Residential Block
floor0.intro:
The power went out years ago. To call the elevator down,
you need to restore power to the fuse box. Find 3 fuses.
floor0.descend_text: THE ELEVATOR SLOWLY DESCENDS INTO THE BASEMENT...
floor1.title: WARD No. 9 — Basement
floor1.intro:
This is where it lives. Three valves control the steam
for the old surface hatch—without them, it won't budge.
floor1.descend_text: THE HATCH LEADS UP TO THE OPEN AIR...
floor2.title: WARD No. 9 — Backyard
floor2.intro:
The yard is ringed with barbed wire. Past it lies the forest.
The shed holds a pair of cutters, but it's secured with 2 padlocks.
Find the keys to get inside.
note.floor0.0:
"...patients from Block B were moved downstairs again. Dr. Crane
forbade asking why. The lights in Corridor B have been flickering for three weeks straight, and nobody comes to fix them..."
note.floor0.1:
"Observation log, night 14: Patient No. 9 doesn't appear in any
admission records. Staff insist he's always been here. We stopped
going down to the basement."
note.floor0.2:
"The panel in the utility room is dead—shut off deliberately, three times now.
Someone doesn't want the elevator down there working. Now I understand why."
note.floor0.3:
"Shift report, 03/14: the patient in Ward 12 asked again about
‘the one who walks in the pipes.’ Staff have been joking about it for
six months. I don't find it funny."
note.floor0.4:
"Ward directive: being in Corridor B after lights-out without
an escort is strictly forbidden. No reason is given in
the order."
note.floor0.5:
"Someone chalked on a locker door: ‘IT COUNTS YOUR STEPS.’
We erased it, of course. It was back the next day, in the
same handwriting."
note.floor0.6:
"Personal file: Patient No. 9 was admitted without a referral, without
relatives, without a birth date. The ‘diagnosis’ field is blank. We
should have asked who brought him here."
note.floor0.7:
"The nurse's aide quit after her third night shift. All she
said was: ‘Someone answers when you call the patients by
their names. It isn't them.’"
note.floor0.8:
"3 a.m. rounds. Ward 9 is empty, door locked from the outside. As
always. As if he was never there at all—just a name
on the plate."
note.floor0.9:
"...they're moving patients downstairs in batches, like they're clearing
the floor. Nobody wants to say what for."
note.floor1.0:
"If you're reading this—don't keep your light on for long. It comes
for the light faster than it comes for sound. I thought it was the other way around. I was wrong, once."
note.floor1.1:
"The valves down here aren't holding back steam. Someone was venting ITS
room. Close them again when you leave. If you leave."
note.floor1.2:
"The boiler room hasn't run since winter, but someone comes down
to check it every night. That name isn't on the shift log."
note.floor1.3:
"It's colder down here than it should be with the heating running.
We checked the pipes three times. The pipes are fine."
note.floor1.4:
"Sign on the utility corridor door: ‘AFTER 22:00 — TWO PEOPLE, NOT
ONE.’ Someone added underneath: ‘IT DIDN'T HELP ANYWAY.’"
note.floor1.5:
"The basement inventory was halted by orders from above. The last
entry in the log cuts off mid-sentence."
note.floor1.6:
"We stopped going for the old equipment in the far bay. Easier
to write off the inventory than go there as two and
come back as one."
note.floor1.7:
"The cage in the corner of the utility bay was here before us. In
the records, it isn't listed as medical equipment,
or as anything else."
note.floor1.8:
"If the ventilation suddenly goes quiet, don't stop to ask why. Just
go back upstairs. It isn't a malfunction."
note.floor1.9:
"Someone welded the grate over the old crawlspace in the wall before
I ever got here. It wasn't welded shut to keep us out."
note.floor2.0:
"The fence has been repaired three times this month. From the outside,
not the inside—like something's trying to get in, not out."
note.floor2.1:
"The shed used to have two locks for a reason. One was for thieves.
The second went on after the cutters disappeared, then turned up
back in their spot, like nobody had ever touched them."
note.floor2.2:
"The forest past the fence isn't part of the hospital grounds on any
official map. The land around it has been listed as ‘unsurveyed’
for forty years."
note.floor2.3:
"Escape attempt, night of July 9th: the patient made it to the gap in
the fence. He was found in the morning ten meters from it, facing
the building, not the forest."
note.floor2.4:
"The night watchman hasn't patrolled the yard after midnight since
it became official policy. No reason is given in the order—
only the time."
note.floor2.5:
"Staff belongings turn up on the fence posts facing the forest
sometimes. Not torn, not discarded—hung up, like they're on
display."
note.floor2.6:
"We keep the cutters in the shed instead of with security on purpose.
If it wants someone to leave through that gap—that decision
shouldn't be its to make."
note.floor2.7:
"The yard is lit worse than the building, even though the wiring is
newer and up to current code. The lamps in the far corner burn out
faster than the rest—the same ones, every time."

editor.help.1.title: VIEWS
editor.help.1.body:
Tab - toggles CAMERA <-> GRID (flat top-down view).
Unavailable during test floor generation.
editor.help.2.title: FREE CAMERA
editor.help.2.body:
WASD - move, SPACE - up, LEFT CTRL - down,
LEFT SHIFT - sprint, right mouse button - look around.
editor.help.3.title: TOOLS (right panel)
editor.help.3.body:
Furniture - click places the selected item under the cursor;
R - rotate furniture under the cursor;
DEL/BACKSPACE - remove furniture under the cursor.
Wall / Eraser - can be dragged with LMB held, paints or
erases cells one at a time.
Doors - click a room border to place/remove a door.
In yard-zone mode interior doors work the same way, and
the zone's border is painted with the Wall/Eraser tool.
editor.help.4.title: DOORS: SCOPE AND KIND
editor.help.4.body:
scope 'link' - the door docks with a neighboring room during
floor generation; 'local' - doesn't dock (for mini-rooms
right at the map edge).
kind: passage - an opening with no object, door - a normal door,
broken - a broken door, window - visible but not passable,
random - the generator picks door/broken/passage itself.
editor.help.5.title: WEIGHT AND REQUIRED FURNITURE
editor.help.5.body:
Generator weight - the higher it is, the more often the generator
picks this room among rooms of the same kind.
exit/unlocker rooms must contain exactly 1 item of the required
kind - it's highlighted in orange.
editor.help.6.title: FILE
editor.help.6.body:
New room / Open list / Save (blocked while there are
errors) / Validate - the same check without saving.
editor.help.7.title: TEST-GENERATE A FLOOR
editor.help.7.body:
Assembles a real floor out of ALREADY-SAVED rooms/zones -
unsaved edits to the current one don't participate.
The generator closes dead-end corridors with the nearest
fitting room itself, and can dock neighboring rooms even
without an exact door match, as long as both have a door
on the right side - sometimes with two passages at once.
editor.help.8.title: OTHER
editor.help.8.body:
The mode button in the right panel toggles Room <-> Yard zone.
ESC - exit test generation, otherwise close the editor.
